thread.topic: Map Issue(s) For Joining Knife Server

posts.subject: Map Issue(s) For Joining Knife Server
posts.bodyHtml:
I am having an issue where I am trying to join the knife server. Here I click the server in the server browser to join as well as connect through the console and it is repeatable. This is where the server has the map 35hp_1go_sweet as its current map. I try to join and I get told on my main screen:

[Bild]


This happens multiple times on many occasions. I have never been able to connect to the server when this map is selected.




As well as this, here is a console entry from when I join the server:


[Bild]
































After multiple attempts at this, my CSGO client eventually crashes with no RAM/CPU usage increase. This message is displayed:


[Bild]


With this message, I cannot open CSGO after. This forces me to verify the integrity of my game cache which resolves the issue allowing it to open. But to still not have any ability to connect to the server when 35hp_1go_sweet is the knife server's map.




As different troubleshoots I have been reloading all workshop items, re-subscribing to the map in question as well as trying to re-install CSGO from the different steam server regions. But yet this still is happening. I hope this is a proficient amount of info to work upon if there is any need to discover the error. If not: I am willing to give any more permitting there is no data risk towards myself.



Kindest Regards,





Fiddles 😄
resubbing from workshop wont help, since the maps dont load from /maps/workshop , they where loaded from /maps only, so you have to delete the map and redownload it from the server
I tried that just now, and tried to open it in a private session. Still the same happened. Thank you for the help/effort for help. Isn't Nachtifrische a mapper?

Hey Fiddles,


usually deleting the map and redownloading should work fine. However, if this is not working for you, try downloading the map directly from Gamebanana () (or here: ) and put it into your maps folder.


If that isn't working either, try reinstalling CSGO but don't forget to save your config files.
Or just don't try to connect to the server for as long as that specific map is played?
That ends up being the case, after verifying my game cache and re-opening CSGO.
